integrity: The geometric lower bound is proved analytically in the two exhaustive side-incidence cases. The central-line reduction is taken from the cited primary literature and was checked in full text. The square endpoint is used only as an external consistency check.
scientific_limitations: The exact optimum is proved for rectangles. The equality classification covers center-passing straight-line bisections only; curved minimizing bisections are not classified, and no extension to general parallelograms is claimed.
title: Exact maximum-relative-diameter bisection of every rectangle
